title: Iris Ohyama breach: date, wording and sources corrected
what_changed: Date changed from 12 November (end of a weekly roundup) to 5 November, the day Iris Plaza announced the possible leak (found 28 October, first announced 29 October). Title and summary said data was exposed; the company says it may have leaked, and the actual number is still under investigation. Added the split of about 5.8 million members and about 1.9 million non-members, unaffected card data, and the operator Iris Plaza. The Privacy Guides roundup was replaced by Netshop Impress and ScanNetSecurity; validation changed from disputed to corroborated.
